item.title: Secure Licensing & Authentication Architecture
item.description:
System Overview

Engineered a secure, end-to-end authentication and licensing ecosystem connecting a client-side loader to a web-based management backend.

  • License Management: Implemented a robust key-generation and verification system, allowing for the programmatic issuance, tracking, and revocation of access keys.
  • User Management: Developed a secure database interface to manage user access, purchase history, and subscription duration.
  • Secure Authentication: Built an encrypted communication pipeline between the loader and the web backend, ensuring that only authenticated hardware IDs (HWID) can access product features.
  • Operational Security: Designed the loader to require valid token-based authentication before initialization, preventing unauthorized access and ensuring license-time enforcement.
  • Tech Stack: Python/C# (Loader), Web-Backend (API Integration), and Secure Cryptographic Token Handling.

item.title: Custom License & Update Management
item.description:
Project Overview

Developed a multi-game loader system with a focus on modular architecture and automated software delivery.

  • Core Features: Automated update fetching from GitHub, custom licensing logic, and hardware ID (HWID) management.
  • Security: Implemented code signing using signtool.exe to ensure software integrity and security.
  • Tech Stack: Python, C#, and C++ for low-level system interaction and UI development.

item.title: Memory Research & Reverse Engineering
item.description:
Technical Research

Focused on deep-level memory manipulation and security research for competitive game titles.

  • Reverse Engineering: Proficient in IDA Pro and x64dbg for binary analysis, signature ripping, and pattern scanning.
  • Memory Manipulation: Experienced in reading memory offsets, hex-based address hunting, and dynamic patching to adapt to game updates.
  • Security: Conducted research into anti-cheat bypass techniques and safe feature implementation.
  • Languages: C++, C#, Assembly.
